item.title: MapLibre Tile: a modern and efficient vector tile format
item.description:
📝 What is MapLibre Tile. MapLibre Tile (MLT) is a succesor to Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT). Both MapLibre GL JS and MapLibre Native now support MLT sources.
🔗 Read more: https://maplibre.org/news/2026-01-23-mlt-release/

item.title: The New Dark Ages
item.description:
📝 I won't enter into the details of what caused the medieval Dark Ages or if they were indeed that "dark". My point of view is that we are living through something similar in modern times. I would add that owning is more important than ever: gathering books, resources, and knowledge.
🔗 Read more: https://yabirgb.com/posts/dark-age/
